## History

Little Jem is the child of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), whose growing needs prompt [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to propose purchasing the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen). This intended move means leaving the family's beloved house of dreams, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds comfort when [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) reveals that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) plans to buy the house for summer vacations.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P21](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P56](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0056), [v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P65](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0065)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--little-jem.md)

Little Jem is the son of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cares deeply for her growing family, which prompts her and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to purchase a larger home in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) to accommodate his needs.
